motivation: Avoid speculative large arrays while removing the legacy 365-block bottleneck and keeping all packed records within signed i64.

block_storage_candidate.physical_storage: reuse two existing i64[365] legacy block arrays as packed block bank 0 and bank 1; no new large array
block_storage_candidate.block_id_encoding: none=0; logical block id N => N+1; radix=731
block_storage_candidate.legacy_first_instruction: not present in final packed block record; IR-v2 instruction carries block_id
block_storage_candidate.legacy_instruction_count: not present in final packed block record; verifier derives membership/cardinality from instruction.block_id

instruction_storage_candidate.physical_storage: reuse ir_ast_event_records_0..3 only after the proven legacy-event-verifier overwrite frontier
instruction_storage_candidate.owner_function_id: not stored in instruction; derive through block_id -> packed_block.owner_function_id
instruction_storage_candidate.rejected_ownerful_reason: owner + 730-block id + opcode + four value-id lanes exceeds signed i64
instruction_storage_candidate.aux_constraint: ID/reference only; raw arbitrary i64 literal payload belongs in value storage
instruction_storage_candidate.required_gate: Native candidate must preserve legacy events through the old verifier, rewrite only after the proven frontier, then pass a new IR-v2 verifier.

call_linkage_without_new_large_array.callee_and_args: existing two-bank call table plus 746-entry call-argument pool

value_storage_candidate.physical_storage: reuse ir_value_records_0..3 after an explicit namespace rebuild
value_storage_candidate.reason_for_fixed_parameter_domain: locals must receive deterministic IDs in one parse pass even when later functions declare additional parameters
value_storage_candidate.legacy_collision: current ir_value_records are a structural numeric-token stream and overlap the planned semantic IDs
unresolved: Large raw i64 literal payloads need a verified value representation.
Aggregate zero-init may reduce structural value pressure but static zero counts are not native headroom.
Legacy numeric-token records must be rebuilt/rebased rather than silently reinterpreted as semantic IDs.

no_new_large_array_rule.exception: Only measured native evidence plus a bounded semantic necessity may authorize a new large array.
